resources.string: Watch sync is available in the connected build. This FOSS build has no Google Play services dependency.

Start the companion on both devices once. Selected pets and appearance settings sync to your paired watch. Automatic handoff keeps one copy, favoring an unlocked phone; otherwise an awake watch. The pet leaves its current screen before appearing on the other device. Both devices deliberately allows separate copies.
Current location: waiting for handoff confirmation
An occasional little attention gesture while awake. Pauses in Quiet Mode and during dragging or handoff. Syncs to the watch.
A light vibration when a tap or hop lands. Respects the device haptic feedback setting.
